about: Adhkar reminder timing. nextReminderTime: today's time if in the future and not shown today; now+300 ms if ≤15 min past and not shown; else tomorrow's. scheduled: scheduleReminders outcome (skipped when disabled, permission not granted, period complete, or no time).

cases.name: before both: fire today at fajr+60 and asr+60
morning already shown today: next morning is tomorrow's
lastShown yesterday does not suppress today
1 ms before the morning time: exact time today
exactly at the morning time (not in the future): catch-up now + 300 ms
10 minutes past, not shown: catch-up now + 300 ms
exactly 15 minutes past: still catch-up (inclusive)
15 minutes + 1 ms past: tomorrow's
10 minutes past but already shown today: tomorrow's
evening within catch-up window
late night: both tomorrow's
just after local midnight with yesterday's lastShown: today's
morning complete by counters: nothing scheduled for morning
evening complete by manual completion: nothing scheduled for evening
morning disabled: only evening scheduled
notification permission not granted: nothing scheduled
no location: no times
method umm-al-qura, hanafi Asr
polar day (Tromsø, June): no sunrise → no times
polar night (Tromsø, December): no sunrise → no times
high latitude summer (Oslo, June): Fajr from night-fraction clamp
